question: In which year did Rohan Bopanna become world number one in the Men's Doubles category of Lawn Tennis?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rohan Bopanna**, a renowned Indian tennis player, achieved the prestigious milestone of becoming **World Number One** in the **Men's Doubles category** in the year **2024**.
 
• This achievement marked a significant milestone in Indian tennis, showcasing his remarkable **skills, dedication, and consistency** in the sport.
 
• Rohan Bopanna has been a key figure in Indian tennis and has represented India in various international tournaments, including the **Davis Cup**.
 
• He is known for his exceptional **serving ability** and has partnered with several top players globally, contributing to his success on the international stage.
 
• Rohan Bopanna's rise to the top ranking reflects not only his individual talent but also highlights the growing prominence of **Indian players in global tennis.**
 
• This achievement is a testament to his **hard work, strategic gameplay, and ability to perform under pressure** in major tournaments.
 
• His success in 2024 serves as an inspiration for young athletes in India aspiring to excel in tennis.
